mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales (client_ref, store_id, terminal_id, shift_id, cashier_id, customer_id, status) VALUES (#{clientRef}, #{storeId}, #{terminalId}, #{shiftId}, #{cashierId}, #{customerId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sales SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sales SET status = 'VOIDED', void_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO receipt_sequences (store_id, last_no) VALUES (#{storeId}, 1) ON CONFLICT (store_id) DO UPDATE SET last_no = receipt_sequences.last_no + 1 RETURNING last_no
